turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, is this Shirley? Hi Shirley, this is Alex calling from Fieldstone Home Products. You entered to receive a free twenty dollar gift card, and I'm calling to schedule a time to drop that off for you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, right. I think I filled that out at the pizza place.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's the one. When we come by with the gift card we also do a quick demonstration of our cleaning system, it also purifies the air.  Short visit, no obligation. Would tomorrow evening around six or Thursday afternoon around two work better for you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thursday afternoon is better. Two is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thursday at two. A couple quick questions so we can prepare. Does anyone in the house have allergies or asthma?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to know. Any pets or small children?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. We do ask that both you and your spouse are there so you can both see it and ask questions. Will that work?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're all set for Thursday at two. You'll get the gift card just for having us out. Thanks Shirley, we'll see you then.
